1iybift: The 1st Sergipe Elementary Olympiad of Innovation and Science (OSFIC) brought engineering and science challenges to public schools in Sergipe in 2026, under the theme “Solutions for a Sustainable Future”. With popsicle sticks and plenty of creativity, teams built bridges, launchers and solar-powered cars, and presented everything at science fairs open to the school community. The olympiad is coordinated by the Federal University of Sergipe (UFS), through its Center for Exact Sciences and Technology (CCET), was selected under the FAPITEC/SE/FUNTEC Call No. 16/2025 with funding from the Government of the State of Sergipe, and is supported by the Sergipe Science Association. Quarks was hired by the project's coordination for the technical execution: school outreach, kits, teaching materials, visual identity, website, data management and communication.

1voapij: Clube de Ciências Quarks is a nonprofit working to transform basic education in Sergipe through innovation in STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics). qk96jl: We want to make Sergipe the largest hub for training tech-minded young people in Brazil's Northeast, bringing cutting-edge research into the classroom through strategic partnerships and structural projects, so that young people from Sergipe lead the future and science drives social development.

u3gaz9: The “Sustainable Energy Is Fundamental” project, carried out in partnership with the Energisa Consumers Council (CONCESE), promoted science and environmental education in public schools in Aracaju and Simão Dias. It delivered low-cost experiment kits covering ten different topics, including Electrostatics, Electromagnetism, Power Generation and Electrical Hazards. It also included teacher training and technical visits, such as to the Xingó Hydroelectric Plant. The methodology used experimentation to connect the curriculum to everyday life, resulting in science fairs and the publication of 12 teaching books.
